problem: A coffee shop that roasts its own beans needs a one-page site: menu, address, hours and table booking from a phone, in a warm style without cafe kitsch.
built: A page with the name and a booking button.
A passport for each coffee, and a menu.
An address on a map scheme, and hours.
Reads on a phone without horizontal scrolling.

shots.caption: On a phone: Book a table and See the menu buttons, the Open now status, and three facts about the shop.
shots.alt: On a phone: Book a table and See the menu buttons, the Open now status, and three facts about the shop.

steps: The first screen shows the name and the booking button.
A passport for each coffee tells the story of the beans.
A booking form closes the page.
offer: A one-page site from your texts and photos.
A booking form connected to your Telegram, email or CRM.
not_included: Hosting, domain and third-party service fees.
